item.title: CSRF on Password Reset Link leading to account takeover.
item.description: Have you ever thought of testing for CSRF vulnerabilities on a password reset link? You might not have, because we generally assume it isn't possible, as the password reset link itself contains a reset token which acts as an alternative to a CSRF token. But is that assumption always correct?
